name: HA Notifications
description: Home Assistant notifications on the panel in the NBA / NFL / NHL Live arcade style: a splash on arrival (ALERT!, WARNING!, SUCCESS!), then a card with the icon and the message in big letters that crawls once so it is always read in full. Critical alerts blink a red border. Webhook and MQTT, named pixel icons and LaMetric icons, and an ALL QUIET idle screen. No header or footer bars.
author: Custom

versions.changes: Arcade redesign: arrival splash, icon tile with severity gradient, big crawling message on a full-height row (no header or footer), blinking critical border, ALL QUIET idle screen, /frame.png preview. Timing now follows the clock instead of per-call counters. Payloads, webhook, MQTT and icons are unchanged.

New notifications now force an immediate on-demand display switch via display_controller's request cache, instead of relying on the passive live-priority check (which the controller skips entirely whenever another mode is already pinned on-demand). Fixes notifications sometimes taking a while to appear.

New notifications now immediately preempt whatever is currently showing instead of waiting in FIFO order behind it — fixes delayed/stale display on rapid state changes (e.g. a light toggled on then off)
Added light icon; added full-color and animated GIF icon support via LaMetric icon gallery IDs (icon_name: lametric:<id>)
